name: ynab-mcp
description: MCP server for YNAB (You Need A Budget).

ynab_budget_id.title: Budget ID (optional)
ynab_budget_id.description: Leave blank to use your default (last-used) budget, or the only budget on the account. Accounts with several budgets and no default must set this; the sync_status tool lists the ids. To pin one, open it at https://app.ynab.com and copy the UUID from the URL (https://app.ynab.com/<budget-id>/budget).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Category groups and categories with their ids, notes and goals; search by category or group name. Month-independent.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: Open accounts split into on-budget and tracking, with balances, section totals and net worth.

tools.name: get_month
tools.description: One month's income, assigned, activity, Ready to Assign and age of money, plus a per-category table with group subtotals.

tools.name: sync_status
tools.description: Budget name, last sync time, transaction count and date range; refresh: true pulls the latest from YNAB.
